title: Personal Weather Forecast
description: What's the weather going to be? NWS forecast dashboard merging hourly and gridpoints data for reliable coverage.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Current forecast temperature with feels-like. Merges hourly (reliable) and gridpoints (extras) sources.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current Temperature: Merge both forecast sources
-- Prefers nws-forecast-hourly (always has temp), falls back to gridpoints
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        -- Prefer hourly (more reliable), fall back to gridpoints
        COALESCE(
            MAX(temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS temperature_c,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(apparent_temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(apparent_temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS apparent_temperature_c,
        -- Heat index and wind chill only from gridpoints
        MAX(heat_index_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast') AS heat_index_c,
        MAX(wind_chill_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast') AS wind_chill_c
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
    GROUP BY valid_time
    ORDER BY valid_time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (temperature_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE temperature_c
    END AS "Air Temp",
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (
            COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN heat_index_c > temperature_c + 2 THEN heat_index_c
                    WHEN wind_chill_c < temperature_c - 2 THEN wind_chill_c
                    ELSE apparent_temperature_c
                END,
                temperature_c
            ) * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE COALESCE(
            CASE
                WHEN heat_index_c > temperature_c + 2 THEN heat_index_c
                WHEN wind_chill_c < temperature_c - 2 THEN wind_chill_c
                ELSE apparent_temperature_c
            END,
            temperature_c
        )
    END AS "Feels Like"
FROM merged_forecast
WHERE temperature_c IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Wind speed and direction with gust. Merges both forecast sources.

targets.rawSql:
-- Current Wind: Merge both forecast sources
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(wind_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(wind_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS wind_speed_kmh,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(wind_gust_kmh) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(wind_gust_kmh) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS wind_gust_kmh,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(wind_direction_deg) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(wind_direction_deg) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS wind_direction_deg
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
    GROUP BY valid_time
    ORDER BY valid_time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    CASE '${wind_unit}'
        WHEN 'mph' THEN ROUND(wind_speed_kmh * 0.621371)
        WHEN 'ms' THEN ROUND(wind_speed_kmh / 3.6, 1)
        ELSE ROUND(wind_speed_kmh)
    END AS "Speed",
    CASE
        WHEN wind_direction_deg IS NULL THEN 'VAR'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg >= 337.5 OR wind_direction_deg < 22.5 THEN 'N'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 67.5 THEN 'NE'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 112.5 THEN 'E'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 157.5 THEN 'SE'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 202.5 THEN 'S'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 247.5 THEN 'SW'
        WHEN wind_direction_deg < 292.5 THEN 'W'
        ELSE 'NW'
    END AS "Direction",
    CASE '${wind_unit}'
        WHEN 'mph' THEN ROUND(COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) * 0.621371)
        WHEN 'ms' THEN ROUND(COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) / 3.6, 1)
        ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh))
    END AS "Gust"
FROM merged_forecast
WHERE wind_speed_kmh IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Humidity
panels.description: Forecast relative humidity. Merges both sources. Comfort range: 30-60%

targets.rawSql:
-- Current Humidity: Merge both forecast sources
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(humidity_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(humidity_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS humidity_pct
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
    GROUP BY valid_time
    ORDER BY valid_time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT humidity_pct AS value
FROM merged_forecast
WHERE humidity_pct IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Cloud Cover
panels.description: Sky condition from gridpoints forecast (when available). Falls back to short_forecast text.

targets.rawSql:
-- Cloud Cover: Primarily from gridpoints, with short_forecast fallback
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        -- sky_cover_pct only from gridpoints
        MAX(sky_cover_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast') AS sky_cover_pct,
        -- short_forecast from hourly as fallback
        COALESCE(
            MAX(short_forecast) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(short_forecast) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS short_forecast
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
    GROUP BY valid_time
    ORDER BY valid_time ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(sky_cover_pct, 0)::INTEGER AS "Cover %",
    CASE
        WHEN sky_cover_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN sky_cover_pct <= 6 THEN 'Clear'
                WHEN sky_cover_pct <= 25 THEN 'Mostly Clear'
                WHEN sky_cover_pct <= 50 THEN 'Partly Cloudy'
                WHEN sky_cover_pct <= 87 THEN 'Mostly Cloudy'
                ELSE 'Cloudy'
            END
        ELSE COALESCE(short_forecast, 'N/A')
    END AS "Condition"
FROM merged_forecast

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Current observed barometric pressure with 3-hour trend (forecasts don't include pressure)

targets.rawSql:
-- Current Pressure from Observations (forecasts don't include pressure)
-- With 3-hour trend calculation
WITH current_obs AS (
    SELECT
        observation_time,
        pressure_pa
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE pressure_pa IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
past_obs AS (
    SELECT
        pressure_pa
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE observation_time <= (SELECT observation_time FROM current_obs) - INTERVAL '3 hours'
      AND observation_time >= (SELECT observation_time FROM current_obs) - INTERVAL '3.5 hours'
      AND pressure_pa IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    CASE '${pressure_unit}'
        WHEN 'inHg' THEN ROUND((c.pressure_pa / 100.0) * 0.02953, 2)
        ELSE ROUND(c.pressure_pa / 100.0, 1)
    END AS "Pressure",
    CASE
        WHEN p.pressure_pa IS NULL THEN 'N/A'
        WHEN c.pressure_pa - p.pressure_pa > 200 THEN 'Rising Fast'
        WHEN c.pressure_pa - p.pressure_pa > 50 THEN 'Rising'
        WHEN c.pressure_pa - p.pressure_pa < -200 THEN 'Falling Fast'
        WHEN c.pressure_pa - p.pressure_pa < -50 THEN 'Falling'
        ELSE 'Steady'
    END AS "Trend"
FROM current_obs c
LEFT JOIN past_obs p ON true

panels.title: Rain Chance
panels.description: Max precipitation probability in next 6 hours. Merges both sources.

targets.rawSql:
-- Rain Chance: Max from both sources in next 6 hours
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(precip_prob_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(precip_prob_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS precip_prob_pct
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '6 hours'
    GROUP BY valid_time
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(precip_prob_pct), 0)::INTEGER AS value
FROM merged_forecast

                    WHEN wind_chill_c < temperature_c - 2 THEN wind_chill_c

panels.title: Wind & Gusts Forecast

targets.rawSql:
-- Wind Speed Forecast Timeline (48 hours) - Merged Sources
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        COALESCE(

            MAX(wind_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS wind_speed_kmh,
        COALESCE(

        ) AS wind_gust_kmh
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
    GROUP BY valid_time
)
SELECT
    valid_time AS time,
    CASE '${wind_unit}'
        WHEN 'mph' THEN wind_speed_kmh * 0.621371
        WHEN 'ms' THEN wind_speed_kmh / 3.6
        ELSE wind_speed_kmh
    END AS "Wind Speed",

        WHEN 'mph' THEN COALESCE(wind_gust_kmh, wind_speed_kmh) * 0.621371

panels.title: Precipitation & Cloud Cover
panels.description: Chance of rain and cloud cover over next 48 hours. Merges both sources.

targets.rawSql:
-- Precipitation Probability and Cloud Cover (48 hours) - Merged Sources
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(precip_prob_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(precip_prob_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS precip_prob_pct,
        -- Cloud cover only from gridpoints
        MAX(sky_cover_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast') AS sky_cover_pct
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
    GROUP BY valid_time
)
SELECT
    valid_time AS time,
    COALESCE(precip_prob_pct, 0) AS "Rain Chance %",
    sky_cover_pct AS "Cloud Cover %"
FROM merged_forecast
ORDER BY valid_time

panels.title: Humidity & Dewpoint Forecast
panels.description: Humidity and dewpoint trends for comfort assessment. Merges both sources.

targets.rawSql:
-- Humidity and Dewpoint Forecast (48 hours) - Merged Sources
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(humidity_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(humidity_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS humidity_pct,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(dewpoint_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(dewpoint_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS dewpoint_c
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= NOW()
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
    GROUP BY valid_time
)
SELECT
    valid_time AS time,
    humidity_pct AS "Humidity %",
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit' THEN (dewpoint_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE dewpoint_c
    END AS "Dewpoint"
FROM merged_forecast
WHERE humidity_pct IS NOT NULL OR dewpoint_c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY valid_time

panels.title: Pressure Trend (Observed)
panels.description: Barometric pressure from observations - key indicator for weather changes

targets.rawSql:
-- Pressure from Observations (24-hour history)
-- Pressure isn't forecast by NWS gridpoints, so we show observed trend
SELECT
    time_bucket('30 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    CASE '${pressure_unit}'
        WHEN 'inHg' THEN AVG(pressure_pa / 100.0) * 0.02953
        ELSE AVG(pressure_pa / 100.0)
    END AS "Pressure"
FROM silver.weather_observations
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= NOW()
  AND pressure_pa IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 7-Day Forecast Summary
panels.description: Daily summary merging both forecast sources for best coverage

targets.rawSql:
-- 7-Day Forecast Summary - Merged Sources
-- Aggregates hourly forecasts into daily summaries, preferring hourly source
WITH merged_forecast AS (
    SELECT
        valid_time,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS temperature_c,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(max_temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast'),
            MAX(temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly')
        ) AS max_temperature_c,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(min_temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast'),
            MAX(temperature_c) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly')
        ) AS min_temperature_c,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(humidity_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(humidity_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS humidity_pct,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(wind_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(wind_speed_kmh) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS wind_speed_kmh,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(precip_prob_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(precip_prob_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS precip_prob_pct,
        MAX(sky_cover_pct) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast') AS sky_cover_pct,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(short_forecast) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-forecast-hourly'),
            MAX(short_forecast) FILTER (WHERE source_stream = 'nws-gridpoints-forecast')
        ) AS short_forecast
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time >= DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW())
      AND valid_time <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'
    GROUP BY valid_time
),
daily_forecasts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(valid_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS forecast_date,
        temperature_c,
        max_temperature_c,
        min_temperature_c,
        humidity_pct,
        wind_speed_kmh,
        precip_prob_pct,
        sky_cover_pct,
        short_forecast
    FROM merged_forecast
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(forecast_date, 'Dy, Mon DD') AS "Day",
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit'
        THEN ROUND(MAX(COALESCE(max_temperature_c, temperature_c)) * 9.0/5.0 + 32)::TEXT || ' F'
        ELSE ROUND(MAX(COALESCE(max_temperature_c, temperature_c)))::TEXT || ' C'
    END AS "High",
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit'
        THEN ROUND(MIN(COALESCE(min_temperature_c, temperature_c)) * 9.0/5.0 + 32)::TEXT || ' F'
        ELSE ROUND(MIN(COALESCE(min_temperature_c, temperature_c)))::TEXT || ' C'
    END AS "Low",
    CASE '${wind_unit}'
        WHEN 'mph' THEN ROUND(AVG(wind_speed_kmh) * 0.621371)::TEXT || ' mph'
        WHEN 'ms' THEN ROUND(AVG(wind_speed_kmh) / 3.6, 1)::TEXT || ' m/s'
        ELSE ROUND(AVG(wind_speed_kmh))::TEXT || ' km/h'
    END AS "Wind",
    ROUND(AVG(humidity_pct))::TEXT || '%' AS "Humidity",
    ROUND(MAX(precip_prob_pct))::TEXT || '%' AS "Rain Chance",
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(sky_cover_pct) IS NOT NULL THEN
            CASE
                WHEN AVG(sky_cover_pct) <= 25 THEN 'Sunny'
                WHEN AVG(sky_cover_pct) <= 50 THEN 'Partly Cloudy'
                WHEN AVG(sky_cover_pct) <= 75 THEN 'Mostly Cloudy'
                ELSE 'Cloudy'
            END
        ELSE 'N/A'
    END AS "Sky",
    MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY short_forecast) AS "Forecast"
FROM daily_forecasts
WHERE temperature_c IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY forecast_date
ORDER BY forecast_date
LIMIT 7
